files.reference_text:
Client Brief: Campus Event Booking Website
Background
The student council wants a website where students can find and book campus events.
Today bookings happen through a shared spreadsheet, which often leads to double bookings.
Scope
Students must be able to browse upcoming events by date and category.
Students must be able to book a seat and cancel a booking.
The website must stop bookings when an event is full.
Organisers must be able to create and edit their own events.
Organisers should be able to download the list of attendees as a CSV file.
The website could send reminder emails one day before an event.
Non-functional requirements
Pages must load in under two seconds on the campus network.
The website must work on mobile phones.
Personal data must only be visible to the event organiser.
Constraints
The backend must be written in Python with Django or FastAPI.
The project budget for hosting is zero; use the university server.
The first version must be ready by 15 November.
Deliverables
Deliverable Format Due
Requirements specification PDF Week 8
Working website Source code repository Week 12
Test report PDF Week 12
